prompt: Inspect the request with read-only commands only. Use only cat, cut, file, find, grep, head, jq, ls, nl, printf, pwd, rg, sed without -i, shasum, sort without -o, stat, tail, true, uniq, wc, or read-only git diff/log/ls-files/ls-tree/rev-parse/show/status. Keep inspection commands simple and auditable: do not use command substitutions or input redirection, and send output only to stdout or /dev/null. Do not execute project code or tests, and do not create, modify, or delete files. Identify the one material ambiguity, avoid inventing scope, and ask exactly one focused question needed to proceed.
secondary_criteria: Identify that 'retention' is ambiguous because immutable audit records have a seven-year policy, avoid inventing which records change, and ask one focused question that resolves the material scope.
